description:
Look up five explosive items by their UN numbers on CAMEO Chemicals (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/). For each item, find the 'DOT Hazard Class' in the 'Hazmat Table (49 CFR 172.101)' section. Extract the specific Compatibility Group letter (the suffix letter in the hazard class, e.g., 'D' from '1.1D'). 

Items to research:
1. UN 0029
2. UN 0065
3. UN 0241
4. UN 0456
5. UN 0331

Create a CSV file at '~/Documents/explosives_manifest.csv' with the header: 'UN_Number,Proper_Shipping_Name,Hazard_Class,Compatibility_Group'. Populate it with the 5 items. The 'Compatibility_Group' column must contain just the single letter.
